# Initializations

Packages

```{r}
#install.packages("pak")
#pak::pak("lillyschwietzer/csarGeo-Package")
library("csarGeo")
library(terra)
library(readxl)
#install.packages("remotes")
#remotes::install_github("lillyschwietzer/csarGeo-Package")
```

Data

```{r}
lu1995 <- rast("data/coa95_raster_20.tif")
data=read_excel("data/coa_pa99_centroides.xlsx")
classif<-read_excel("data/coa_aves_classification.xlsx")
```

# Calibrating the projections

```{r}
res <- countryside_sar(
  data = data,
  crs = 3763,
  method = "circles",
  radius = 2000 * 1:10,
  habitat = lu1995,
  habitat_names = c("Forest", "Agriculture", "Shrubland"),
  classification = classif,
  groups = "Forest",
  seed = 123
)
```

# Visualization

```{r}
visuals_sar(res, plot_type = "map")
```
